subject: Correct showcase places in DEVELOPMENT.md and the marine script
description: Follow-up to task 0147 (PR #141), requested by Tobias on 2026-11-06. docs/DEVELOPMENT.md still carries the old tab table and wrong places: grazing is at Munkarp in Skåne (not Öland), and commercial marine is in Öresund between Helsingborg and Helsingør (not Kalmarsund/Öland). scripts/generate_marine_commercial_showcase.py's docstring and CLI description still say Kalmarsund although its bbox is Öresund. Scope: replace the tab table with a short accurate summary, fix the place annotations in the file tree and command comments, and fix the script's docstring and description. Not in scope: the rest of the file tree inventory. Review: owner verdict (Codex unavailable).
